review.notes: Fixing review of the package (README 172 targets, Suggested.lean 587 sorry warnings). Fixed in place: 10 forward references resolved by moving targets; every target now shows its slug so Requires lines resolve; 2 process-language passages removed; He 2018 locators renumbered to the arXiv v3 section numbering with pages (the journal-count labels 15/16/17 were mixed in); one wrong statement in RG2.4 (double-coset cardinalities q^{l(w)} corrected to q^{l-breve(w)} per He Lem. 4.6 and Richarz Prop. 1.11), one in RG2.3 (lft Neron model finite type iff T anisotropic over K^sh, not over K), one inconsistent description in RG2.2 (GSp building, m in R, fixed points of the involution are B(Sp)); ~45 locators corrected (Bruhat-Tits I/II pages and items, Haines-Rapoport, Richarz, Casselman, GLX, van Hoften, Kaletha, Zhu, Kisin-Pappas); 20 sub-statements that no public source states are now explicitly marked as stated-as-used (gaps) instead of silent claims; 67 API names of 15 definitions added to the Lean closing catalogue. Checks: lean-check exit 0 with 587 sorry warnings and no other warning; intake check-files 0 problems; no duplication of any current upstream roadmap or of TauCeti a91d3aaf (no target removed); all 84 packet nodes present verbatim. Residual for the maintainer: README is 207 KB (guideline at most 200 KB; the slug anchors and gap markings added 10 KB); the consumer packages AdelicAlgebraicGroups and SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups attribute to this roadmap a few notions it does not plan (comodule/tensor dictionary, Kneser-Tits, quasi-splitness at almost all places, integral Iwasawa decomposition, closed homogeneous embeddings; relative roots are ReductiveGroups layer 7) - to be fixed on their side; 12 cited sources were not available for checking (Garrett, Milne, Edixhoven, Stacks, Pilloni, Anantharaman, Lipnowski-Tsimerman, Harpaz-Wittenberg, Cesnavicius, Calegari-Geraghty, Kisin-Pappas-Zhou, Prasad-Yu).
